Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 12, 2026

My Square Face Icon is designed as a browser-based classic Flash avatar maker page. The main game runs through Ruffle so visitors can play the SWF game in modern browsers without installing Adobe Flash Player.

This privacy policy explains what information is provided through public comments, how moderation uses it, and which details are not shown publicly.

Privacy Policy: Information We Collect

We do not require accounts to use the generator. If you submit a public comment, we collect the name, email address, rating, comment text, and optional image you provide. Your email is used for moderation context and is not displayed publicly.

Generated Images

The game runs in your browser. If you save an image through the original game or take a screenshot of your creation, that action is handled by your browser or device.

Comment Images

Optional comment images are limited to JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF files up to 2MB. Approved comments may show the uploaded image publicly. Rejected or deleted comments may have their image removed from storage.

Cookies and Local Storage

The site may use local storage to remember whether you dismissed the PWA install prompt and to keep a simple visitor ID for comment likes. The visitor ID is used to reduce duplicate likes from the same browser and is not a login account.

This browser may also save the stable ID and start time of recently played games to show Continue Playing. You can remove that history with Clear history, and it does not sync across devices.

If you use Favorite or Save tool, this browser stores only stable game IDs so it can show your saved games and tools on the Games page. Favorites do not contain account or personal information and do not sync across devices. Press the Favorited or Saved tool button again to remove an item, or clear this site's stored data in your browser settings.

Comment likes may store a hashed visitor identifier with the comment ID in Cloudflare KV. This helps count likes without showing your identity on the public page. The moderation area may use configured secrets or request headers to protect admin actions.

Friend Quiz Links and Results

Friend Block Test processes nicknames, answers and scores in your browser without uploading them. Quiz and result links contain their data after # and can be read by anyone who has the link. This browser keeps up to 20 created-quiz identifiers and the latest 50 received results (nicknames, avatars and scores), with no account or device sync. The original answer list is carried in the link, not the local results list. Use Clear quiz records in the game to remove its identifiers and results. Storage restrictions or clearing site data may prevent collecting future results for a quiz. Third-party analytics and advertising are disabled on the quiz page and its embedded game.

Analytics and Advertising

Advertising is not enabled by default. Cloudflare Web Analytics may be added when a site token is configured, helping measure aggregate traffic without requiring accounts.

Contact

For privacy questions, use the contact page or email contact@mysquarefaceicon.com.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 17, 2026

My Square Face Icon (mysquarefaceicon.com) is designed as a browser-based classic Flash avatar maker page. The main game runs through Ruffle so visitors can play the SWF game in modern browsers without installing Adobe Flash Player.

This privacy policy explains what information is provided through public comments, what this browser stores locally, which cookies and identifiers third-party analytics and advertising services may use, and the choices you have.

Privacy Policy: Information We Collect

We do not require accounts to use the generator. If you submit a public comment, we collect the name, email address, rating, comment text, and optional image you provide. Your email is used for moderation context and is not displayed publicly.

Generated Images

The game runs in your browser. If you save an image through the original game or take a screenshot of your creation, that action is handled by your browser or device.

Comment Images

Optional comment images are limited to JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF files up to 2MB. Approved comments may show the uploaded image publicly. Rejected or deleted comments may have their image removed from storage.

Cookies and Local Storage

The site may use local storage to remember whether you dismissed the PWA install prompt and to keep a simple visitor ID for comment likes. The visitor ID is used to reduce duplicate likes from the same browser and is not a login account.

This browser may also save the stable ID and start time of recently played games to show Continue Playing. You can remove that history with Clear history, and it does not sync across devices.

If you use Favorite or Save tool, this browser stores only stable game IDs so it can show your saved games and tools on the Games page. Favorites do not contain account or personal information and do not sync across devices. Press the Favorited or Saved tool button again to remove an item, or clear this site's stored data in your browser settings.

Comment likes may store a hashed visitor identifier with the comment ID in Cloudflare KV. This helps count likes without showing your identity on the public page. The moderation area may use configured secrets or request headers to protect admin actions.

Friend Quiz Links and Results

Friend Block Test processes nicknames, answers and scores in your browser without uploading them. Quiz and result links contain their data after # and can be read by anyone who has the link. This browser keeps up to 20 created-quiz identifiers and the latest 50 received results (nicknames, avatars and scores), with no account or device sync. The original answer list is carried in the link, not the local results list. Use Clear quiz records in the game to remove its identifiers and results. Storage restrictions or clearing site data may prevent collecting future results for a quiz. The surrounding quiz page uses Google Analytics, AdSense and Cloudflare Web Analytics. The private link fragment is removed from the outer page address before those scripts run and passed locally to the embedded game; it is not included in analytics page URLs. The embedded game does not load analytics or ads. Keep the original invitation or use the game's Copy link button to share or reopen it; copying the cleaned address bar does not copy the quiz.

Advertising and Google AdSense

Public pages may display ads served by Google AdSense. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet. These vendors may also use web beacons, device identifiers, and IP addresses to measure ads and limit how often you see them.

You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's{" "} Ads Settings. You can also opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies for personalized advertising at{" "} www.aboutads.info{" "} or, in Europe,{" "} www.youronlinechoices.eu. Opting out of personalization does not remove ads; you may still see non-personalized ads.

To learn how Google uses data when you visit sites that use its services, see{" "} How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services . We do not send names, email addresses, comment text, or Friend Block Test quiz data to advertising services, and we do not ask the ad code to target ads using sensitive categories.

Analytics

Public pages may use Google Analytics and Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure visits and performance. These services can receive page, device and network information, and Google Analytics may set cookies subject to consent and browser settings. You can block analytics with your browser's cookie controls or with the{" "} Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on . Friend Block Test does not send quiz nicknames, answers, scores or share-link contents to these services. On that page, analytics and ad storage and ad personalization default to denied. Ad availability depends on consent, browser settings and the provider; this does not require a game account.

Consent for Visitors in Europe

Where the law requires consent, for example for visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, a consent message may ask whether cookies and similar technologies can be used for personalized ads and measurement. Your choice controls whether those uses are allowed, and you can change it later from the same message or by clearing this site's cookies.

Hosting and Security Logs

The site is delivered through Cloudflare. Like most web hosts, Cloudflare processes IP addresses and request details to deliver pages, block abuse, and keep the service secure. Comment text is stored in Cloudflare KV and optional comment images are stored in Cloudflare R2.

Location Data

The site does not request precise location from your device. Advertising and analytics providers may estimate a general region from your IP address.

Children's Privacy

The site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has submitted a comment with personal information, contact us and we will review and remove it.

Your Choices and Requests

You can clear cookies and local storage for this site in your browser at any time. To ask for a comment or uploaded image to be corrected or removed, send the comment name, date and page URL through the contact details below.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy when the site adds or changes features, analytics, or advertising. The date at the top of this page shows the latest revision.

Contact

For privacy questions, use the contact page or email contact@mysquarefaceicon.com.
